articles.title: How to begin learning Mandarin Chinese
articles.content: This original orientation introduces Mandarin Chinese as a system of meaningful forms used in context. Start with Mandarin tones, Pinyin, characters and aspect particles. Work in short sessions: listen or read, notice a pattern, retrieve it from memory, and use it in a new example. For historical, regional and specialist questions, consult the source list and seek qualified review.
